text: A patient wetland gardener with a living shell. Brush adults for a naturally shed Mossback Scale.
Mossbacks wade in Overworld swamps and mangrove swamps. In the March they crowd the Reed Fen, and a few wander the Crystal Fields, the Steppe and the Snow Fields.
A Mossback has **30 health** and **6 armour**, and moves slowly. It is gentle and backs away from monsters. Breed two with **seagrass**.
pages.title: Where you find it

text: Brush an adult for a **Mossback Scale**, once a minute. Scales bind into 2 Spiritweave under Water, and the Rootbinders favour them as an offering.
If you hunt one it drops **2 to 4 Raw Game**, more with Looting, cooked if it died burning.
pages.title: What it gives

text: A bonded Mossback is a walking saddlebag with **9 slots** (12 with the Deep Pocket mark). It drops everything in its bag if it dies.
See the [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts) page for how to open the bag and send it to wait.
